text:
Amy: Heads-up — Lantern's presales asked for exact staging egress IPs and our plan for deprecated endpoints during the POC. Can ops + legal triage? cc @Dan @Maria :eyes:
Dan: We can hand over a small set of static egress IPs from our staging pool. For Hosted POC we use region-based NATs, for Dedicated we can do VPC peering.
Maria: They specifically want CIDRs to add to their firewall before tomorrow's smoke test. I'll pull the current list — pinging Infra.
InfraBot: export complete. sample CIDRs: `54.210.12.0/24`, `3.120.45.0/24`, `34.201.78.0/26`. Full CSV uploaded to https://redwood.internal/poc-lantern/ips.csv :white_check_mark:
Samir: Important: Lantern's adapter maps competitor param `stop_sequence` to our `stop_tokens`. They reported subtle truncation diffs on long chat turns. We should document mapping + a mitigation path (post-process trimming + n=1 fallback).
Amy: Good call. Also they asked about deprecated endpoints: they run some integration that hits `/v1/legacy/generate`. If we plan to retire that name we need to ensure their POC doesn't break. What's the safe deprecation window for a paid POC?
LegalBot: For enterprise POCs we recommend a freeze for the duration of the engagement. If deprecation is unavoidable, standard notice is 30 days, but for a live POC we can grant an exception in writing. Send the POC start/end dates and we'll add a temporary compatibility clause.
Dan: We can add a compatibility proxy that rewrites `/v1/legacy/generate` -> `/v1/llm/generate` for the POC. Low-risk, quick config change. ETA 2 business days to deploy to staging.
Maria: I'll coordinate the proxy and add a short test checklist. Can we also provide sample request/response examples showing the stop token behavior? Lantern wants side-by-side examples.
Samir: I'll create a small repo with example requests, expected outputs, and a short note on batching/latency differences. Will include prompt templates and suggested knob settings (temperature, top_p, max_tokens).
Amy: Pricing question from Lantern: are POC infra costs covered by credits or will they receive a reduced eval invoice? They're comparing token math vs incumbent.
Dan: For this deal we usually offer $5k credits + capped infra for Dedicated-like perf. Any overage billed at eval rates. Sales Ops: confirm if Lantern signed the standard POC MSA.
Amy: @LegalBot can you confirm clause language for credits vs invoice? Also need KMS/HSM requirements — Lantern asked about bringing their own KMS.
LegalBot: BYOK can be supported on Private or Dedicated. For Hosted, we offer customer-managed keys via partner KMS in select regions — requires a short security addendum. I'll send the template.
InfraBot: added a ticket: STG-NAT-412 to publish final CIDRs and proxy rollout plan. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/STG-NAT-412
Maria: Action items: 1) Dan: proxy deploy ETA 2 days. 2) Infra: publish CIDRs (done). 3) Samir: example repo + parity notes by EOD. 4) Legal: temp compatibility clause + BYOK addendum.
Amy: Thanks all — Lantern kickoff is 48hrs. Let's aim to have the proxy + examples ready for their smoke test. :rocket:
